dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です本日はご相談ありがとうございます年齢、性別、相談内容を教えて下さい
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for your consultation today. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and the nature of your concern?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。宜しくお願い致します。44歳、女、今の会社を辞めようか悩んでいます。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you. I'm 44 years old, female, and I'm struggling with whether to quit my current company.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。会社を辞めようと悩まれてるんですね
dialogue.content: Thank you. So you’re feeling conflicted about leaving your company.

dialogue.origin: 今の会社で何かあった感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Has something happened at your current company?

dialogue.origin: 上司のパワハラです。入社当時は良い人でした。子育て中の私にすごく理解をしめしてくれ、子供が熱出した時とかも休ませてくれたりなど。でも何でもイエスと言わないといけない雰囲気で…こちらが下手に出てれば機嫌良いのですが、一度逆らってしまってから態度が急変しました。
dialogue.content: It's power harassment from my supervisor. When I first joined, he seemed like a good person. He was very understanding about my childcare responsibilities and would let me take time off when my child had a fever. But there's an atmosphere where you have to say yes to everything... As long as I defer to him, he's in a good mood, but after I pushed back once, his attitude changed dramatically.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、お辛い雰囲気ですね
dialogue.content: I see, that must be a difficult atmosphere for you.

dialogue.origin: 上司の方は職場内の人にも同じような態度をされてる感じですか
dialogue.content: Does your supervisor treat other people at work in a similar way?

dialogue.origin: 以前はパワハラで訴えられた事があると聞きましたが、現在のメンバーでは私以外にはかなり感じがいいです。私にだけあたりがキツイです。
dialogue.content: I heard he was previously accused of power harassment, but with the current team, he’s quite pleasant to everyone except me. He’s only harsh toward me.

dialogue.origin: 上司の言うことを何でも受け入れニコニコしている人や、職場で権力や影響力がある人には楽しそうに世間話までしています。
dialogue.content: He even has friendly small talk with people who smile and accept whatever he says, and with those who have power or influence at work.

dialogue.origin: 当たりがキツイと、会社行きたくなくなりますね・・・一度逆らったとありますが、具体的に教えてもらうことは可能でしょうか？
dialogue.content: When someone is harsh with you, it makes you not want to go to work, doesn't it? You mentioned you went against him once; would it be possible for you to tell me about that in more detail?

dialogue.origin: はい、顔を見るのが辛いです。ある時期立て続けに社員が退職してしまいました。人件費削減なのか、社員を募集せず業務を私にやらせようとし。ある程度は引き受けてやっていますが、更に増えそうな時に、これ以上は難しいかもしれませんこの一言から急変してしまいました。どうせ暇な癖にと、タスク管理ができていないと言われました。
dialogue.content: Yes, it's painful just to see his face. For a time, several employees resigned one after another. Maybe it was to cut labor costs, but he tried to make me do their work without hiring new staff. I took on a certain amount of it, but when it seemed like it was going to increase further, I said, 'This might be more than I can handle.' His attitude changed drastically after that one comment. He told me I couldn't manage my tasks properly and said I must be idle anyway.

dialogue.origin: それはお辛いですね・・・周りの退職者の方は、同じような対応されていたのですか？
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult... Were the people who resigned treated in a similar way?

dialogue.origin: パワハラ上司のせいで退職した人は私はかぶっていないので分からないです。今いる人に聞いた話です。怒鳴られ嫌になって辞めたと。
dialogue.content: My time at the company didn't overlap with the people who quit because of the harassing boss, so I don't know firsthand. It's what I heard from current employees. They said they got yelled at and couldn't take it anymore, so they quit.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね今更ですが、なんとお呼びしたらよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: I see. This is a bit late to ask, but how would you like me to address you?

dialogue.origin: まさ　でお願いします
dialogue.content: Please call me Masa.

dialogue.origin: まささんですねありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you, Masa.

dialogue.origin: まささんは今の職場の現状で、辞めることにどう思われていますか？
dialogue.content: Masa, given the current situation at your workplace, how do you feel about quitting?

dialogue.origin: かなり迷っています。年齢的なこと、転職回数を考えると難しいのかなと。また子供が小さく今の職場が自宅から近く残業が無い為、同じ条件だと更に厳しいです。ただ、我慢し続けるのもキツイなと。
dialogue.content: I’m very torn. Considering my age and how many times I’ve changed jobs, it might be difficult. My child is young, and my current workplace is close to home with no overtime, so finding the same conditions would be even harder. But continuing to endure this is tough.

dialogue.origin: あと転職したとしても、また同じタイプの人はどこにでもいるのでは？とも…
dialogue.content: Also, I wonder if I'll just run into the same type of person wherever I go, even if I change jobs...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、お子さんの事も心配になりますね家族のことも考えられてるんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. It’s natural to be concerned about your child—you’re thinking of your family as well.

dialogue.origin: はい、残業で子供に淋しい思いはさせたくないんです。
dialogue.content: Yes, I don’t want my child to feel lonely because I’m working overtime.

dialogue.origin: あと主人が平日帰りが遅いため全く頼れないのも大きいです。
dialogue.content: Another big factor is that my husband comes home late on weekdays, so I can't rely on him at all.

dialogue.origin: でも我慢することはキツイですよね、転職に不安があると思いますが、現状で何か転職活動とかされていますか？
dialogue.content: But it's hard to endure it, isn't it? I understand you're anxious about changing jobs, but are you currently doing any job hunting?

dialogue.origin: 本気の転職活動とまではいかなくても、求人サイトを除いたり、エージェントと話をしたりはしています。ただ残業なしはほぼ無いです。
dialogue.content: It's not what I'd call a serious job search, but I do browse job sites and talk to agents. However, there are almost no jobs with no overtime.

dialogue.origin: 条件が合わないことが多いんですね・・・今の職場で頼る人とかは、いますか？
dialogue.content: It seems many don't match your conditions... Is there anyone at your current workplace you can rely on?

dialogue.origin: 全体的に体育会系でギスギスした雰囲気の職場でして…一人気の合う人がいたのですが、先月退職してしまいました…
dialogue.content: It's a very tense workplace with a rigid, hierarchical culture... There was one person I got along with, but they resigned last month...

dialogue.origin: またパワハラ相談窓口の担当者が、その張本人となっていて相談もできないです。
dialogue.content: Also, the person in charge of the power harassment consultation desk is the perpetrator himself, so I can't consult them.

dialogue.origin: 退職されたのですね、それは辛いですね
dialogue.content: So they resigned... That must be difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: なかなかお辛い状況の中ですが、パートナーさんとは何か話をされていますか？
dialogue.content: It sounds like a very tough situation, but have you spoken with your partner about it?

dialogue.origin: パワハラが許せない、俺が文句言ってやると怒っていましたが、そんな事をしたら益々居づらくなるので止めました。辞めていいよ、俺が養うからと言ってくれたら楽になれるのですが、働いてもらわないと困るという考え方なので…
dialogue.content: He was angry, saying he couldn't tolerate the harassment and that he'd go complain, but I stopped him because that would only make it even harder for me to stay there. I would feel so relieved if he just said, 'It's okay to quit; I'll support you,' but his mindset is that he needs me to work.

dialogue.origin: 働かざる者食うべからずと以前に言われたので、辞めるなら次決めてからじゃないと良い顔しないと思います。
dialogue.content: He once told me, 'He who does not work, neither shall he eat,' so I don't think he'll be happy unless I have another job lined up before I quit.

dialogue.origin: 最近は、失業保険とかあると思いますが、そこら辺はどのように考えていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: These days, there are things like unemployment insurance. Have you thought about that at all?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、それをもらうのもありかもしれませんが、ずっともらえるものでは無いので。その先が不安ですね。正社員に就ける保証がないのが…
dialogue.content: Yes, receiving that might be an option, but it doesn't last forever. I'm worried about what comes after. There's no guarantee I can find another full-time position...

dialogue.origin: 正社員に就ける保証がないんですね不安は常に、まとわりつきますね・・・
dialogue.content: So there's no guarantee of finding a full-time position. That anxiety is always clinging to you, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: もっと若かったり、専門職であればとっくに辞めていたかも
dialogue.content: If I were younger or had a specialized profession, I probably would have quit long ago.

dialogue.origin: まささんは今現状を脱したいと思われていると思います
dialogue.content: Masa, I sense that you want to escape your current situation.

dialogue.origin: 何か打開できそうなことありそうですか？
dialogue.content: Does anything come to mind that might be a breakthrough?

dialogue.origin: 思い浮かばなくて…自分の認知を変えるしかないのかなとか。どこに行っても嫌な人はいるものでしょうかね？
dialogue.content: Nothing comes to mind... I wonder if the only option is to change my own perspective. I suppose there are unpleasant people everywhere you go, aren't there?

dialogue.origin: 嫌な人はいると思いますが、会社外で、パワハラをつらえる方法とかはない感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I do think there will always be difficult people, but is there any way to address or report the power harassment outside the company?

dialogue.origin: 労働局には相談しました。
dialogue.content: I have consulted the Labor Bureau.

dialogue.origin: 本日はお時間となりましたので、またのご相談をお待ちしております本日はありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Our time is up for today. I look forward to our next session. Thank you very much for today.

dialogue.origin: 本日はありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you very much for today!

topic.sub: 上司からのパワハラに対する悩み
